misconceptions.description: Asking the AI whether it is correct as the only check.
misconceptions.trigger: learner asks 'are you sure?' and accepts yes
misconceptions.feedback: A model can confidently confirm its own errors. Check independent sources.

misconceptions.description: Treating an AI use plan as fixed.
misconceptions.trigger: learner writes the plan once and never revisits it
misconceptions.feedback: Revisit the plan as tools, course policies and your goals change.
